description: Source code for JSON reading and parsing functionality in the Chromium project, including error handling and utility functions.

classes.name: JSONReader
classes.description: Class providing static methods for reading JSON strings and error handling, and instance methods for parsing with error info.

methods.name: JSONReader::Read
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a Value object, with options and max depth.

methods.name: JSONReader::ReadAndReturnError
methods.description: Parses JSON and provides detailed error information if parsing fails.

methods.name: JSONReader::ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a JSON parse error code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: JSONReader::ReadToValue
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a Value object using internal parser.

methods.name: JSONReader::error_code
methods.description: Returns the last error code from parsing.

methods.name: JSONReader::GetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the last error message from parsing.
